SELECT toUnixTimestamp(f.fts) AS t, f.lat AS lat
FROM (SELECT request_id::String AS rid, ts::DateTime64(3) AS fts, served_by::String AS sb, fallback_reason::String AS fr,
       clicked::String AS clk, purchased::String AS pur, revenue_eur::Float64 AS rev, latency_ms::Nullable(Float64) AS lat,
       shown::Array(String) AS shown_items
FROM team_37.feedback WHERE request_id::String != '__init__') AS f WHERE f.sb = 'team' AND f.fts >= '2026-11-14 12:09:00' AND f.fts < '2026-11-15 08:40:42' AND cityHash64(f.rid) % 40 = 0
ORDER BY t SETTINGS max_execution_time = 28
